import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/data/nls_bmi_processed.csv')
df.head()

# Filter the dataset for Hispanic men
hispanic_men = df[(df['GENDER'] == 'MALE') & (df['HISPANIC'] == 1)]

# Display the first few rows of the filtered dataset
hispanic_men.head()

# Calculate mean BMI for different savings behavior categories
mean_bmi_dissaved = hispanic_men[hispanic_men['DISSAVED'] == 1]['BMI'].mean()
mean_bmi_samesave = hispanic_men[hispanic_men['SAMESAVE'] == 1]['BMI'].mean()
mean_bmi_neither = hispanic_men[(hispanic_men['DISSAVED'] == 0) & (hispanic_men['SAMESAVE'] == 0)]['BMI'].mean()

# Perform a regression analysis
import statsmodels.api as sm

# Define independent variables (time preference indicators and control variables)
X = hispanic_men[['DISSAVED', 'SAMESAVE', 'AGE', 'INCOME']]
X = sm.add_constant(X)  # Add a constant term for the intercept

# Define the dependent variable
y = hispanic_men['BMI']

# Fit the regression model
model = sm.OLS(y, X).fit()

# Get the summary of the regression results
model.summary()
